arguments.title: Riverside Terminal Filming-Access Brief – PT-882
arguments.body:
Riverside Terminal Filming-Access Brief
Permit Reference: PT-882

Date: October 12, 2026
Time: 07:00 – 11:00

Entry: Gate 3
Crew Check-in: South Security Desk

Permitted Equipment:
- Two (2) shoulder cameras
- One (1) battery light

Conditions:
- The public concourse must remain unobstructed at all times during filming.

This brief reflects the current approved permit decision. All crew members must comply with the above conditions.

The document must be shared only with the exact municipal liaison destination record.
